name: Philadelphia Original Cream Cheese (Plain Spread)
whyItWorks: Smooth, velvety, and completely free of roughage, nuts, or seeds. It coats white bread or plain bagels comfortably and provides quick, dense calories during recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread a modest layer (1 tablespoon) onto soft white bread, plain bagel, or saltines. Take a lactase tablet if sensitive to unaged dairy.
watchOuts: Contains unaged milk and cream (moderate lactose and saturated fat); avoid thick heavy schmears during active flare-ups.
